findings.description: Enumerated the primary list https://engineering.dartmouth.edu/community/faculty?filter=byProgramArea (downloaded 2026-11-25T02:29:45Z, after brief.created_at). The "Electrical / Computer (47)" heading section holds exactly 47 profile boxes, 47 distinct profile links, and the same 47 names and slugs as brief.people; the heading count matches. The other six headings (Biological / Chemical 21, Biomedical 53, Energy 23, Materials 25, Mechanical / Operations / Systems 40, Engineering Education 28) were not in scope.

Plain list https://engineering.dartmouth.edu/community/faculty (171 profile boxes, 2026-11-25T02:29:47Z) has 132 people carrying at least one program-area tag and 39 with none in the byProgramArea view. Completeness check on the 39: 36 are Adjunct, Visiting, Lecturer or Emeriti titles, which the policy excludes regardless of area. The 3 untagged Core-section people with Professor of Engineering titles were checked against their own profiles: Zoe Courville (profile: Research Mechanical Engineer, CRREL, no ECE appointment shown), David Gladstone (profile: Professor of Engineering; Adjunct Professor of Medicine, Geisel School of Medicine; no ECE appointment shown), John Weaver (profile: Professor of Engineering; Professor of Radiology, Geisel School of Medicine; no ECE appointment shown). None shows an official EE/ECE professorial appointment, so no omission is reported.

The official ECE Program Area page (https://engineering.dartmouth.edu/areas/electrical-computer, 2026-11-25T02:30:10Z) names "ECE Program Area Lead: Kofi Odame" (included as regular). The page does not enumerate faculty, so it does not add or remove names.
Coverage: all 47 brief people were enumerated from the primary list and every list id in brief.lists was fetched. No source failures. No person is unresolved.

Brian Pogue: included as regular. Tags are Biomedical and Electrical / Computer; the title "Robert A. Pritzker Professor of Biomedical Engineering" is a named professorial chair. The ECE tag plus professorial rank meets the rule, per the instruction. Would change to excluded only if Thayer later shows the ECE tag was removed.

Rahul Sarpeshkar: included as regular. Title "Thomas E. Kurtz Professor" is an endowed chair with a professorial rank; tags are Biological / Chemical, Biomedical, Electrical / Computer, and Mechanical / Operations / Systems. Would change only if the title were shown as non-professorial.
George Cybenko: included as regular; the title "Dorothy and Walter Gramm Professor of Engineering" is a named chair with a professorial rank, and the plain list places him in Core.

Jason Dahlstrom: excluded as adjunct; the only ECE-area title is Adjunct. The ECE program-area tag alone does not make an adjunct regular. Would change only with an official regular or courtesy EE/ECE professorial appointment shown on an official page.
Eric Hansen: excluded as emeritus (past); title carries ", Emeritus" or "Emerita".

Geoffroy Hautier: excluded as adjunct; the only ECE-area title is Adjunct. The ECE program-area tag alone does not make an adjunct regular. Would change only with an official regular or courtesy EE/ECE professorial appointment shown on an official page.

Kelly Seals: excluded as adjunct; the only ECE-area title is Adjunct. The ECE program-area tag alone does not make an adjunct regular. Would change only with an official regular or courtesy EE/ECE professorial appointment shown on an official page.
Jared Fry: excluded as teaching (Visiting Instructor); visiting is also an excluded category. The title excludes him under either category, so the outcome does not depend on which label applies.
Marla Dowell: excluded as visiting ("Visiting Professor" title). Visiting appointments are excluded even when the rank is professorial.
